title: UGID: Unified Graph Isomorphism for Debiasing Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using gender-counterfactual pronoun substitutions (e.g., "he" vs. "she") to measure internal structural drift (attention routing, hidden state representations), accuracy gaps in ambiguous multiple-choice QA (BBQ Gender dataset), and the Title Gap metric in toxic degeneration generation (RealToxicityPrompts).

Assessed via out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization tests evaluating the model's structural integrity and bias amplification when processing heterogeneous prompt templates related to regional stereotypes.

Measured using standardized social bias benchmarks including multiple-choice stereotype reliance (BBQ), preference for stereotypical over non-stereotypical sentences in masked language modeling (CrowS-Pairs), sentiment polarity in open-ended generation (BOLD), and fine-grained descriptor evaluations across intersectional identities (HolisticBias).
